outcome: need for mechanical ventilation (MV) at <72 hours of life
successful weaning from continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP)
cohort: The study included 155 neonates less than 34 weeks of gestational age (median 32 weeks) who had respiratory distress syndrome (RDS).
finding: The lung ultrasound score (LUS) demonstrated significant predictive ability for important outcomes in neonatal respiratory distress syndrome (RDS), including the need for surfactant, mechanical ventilation, and successful CPAP withdrawal.
